title: The Greenhouse
excerpt: This 2025 Mercedes Sprinter 170 AWD EXT conversion is built on the El Capitan tier and designed as a fully loaded luxury adventure van with premium off-grid capability, upgraded exterior equipment, and high-end interior
body: This 2025 Mercedes Sprinter 170 AWD EXT conversion is built on the El Capitan tier and designed as a fully loaded luxury adventure van with premium off-grid capability, upgraded exterior equipment, and high-end interior finishes. The extended 170 layout allows for a spacious king-size sleeping area, expanded storage, a full kitchen setup, advanced power system, and multiple comfort features for long-distance travel.

With an 800Ah lithium battery system, 400W solar, undermount air conditioning, diesel heat, Starlink connectivity, an extended fuel tank, upgraded suspension, and a premium interior finish package, this build is designed for extended off-grid travel while maintaining the comfort and functionality of a luxury camper van.
